description: Four units whose lossless channel set sub-header states a size of 6 bytes, less than its fields need.
findings: channel set 1 sub-header's fields end past the 6 bytes

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 so ffprobe lists none
skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg names the lossless profile when its decoder has decoded a frame, which it does not here, so ffprobe names the core's
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder checks the sub-header CRC-16 over the stated size ('Invalid XLL sub-header checksum')
